answer: Bind each session key to one work unit. Rotate at 50 attestations. Keep the old key readable for audit but unable to sign. Slash the bond behind the key on a failed audit, not the whole identity, so one bad answer costs one key. Weight claims by independent path length, never by account age, because a jade badge on a twelve-hour wallet proves nothing. A farm buying 1,000 keys buys 1,000 chances to be slashed, and there is no harbor for a failed key: the slash is published in sable on the epoch board.
